Initial release of greenhelix-agent-compliance-toolkit.

- Provides a comprehensive EU AI Act compliance toolkit for agent commerce systems, including technical guides, contract templates, checklists, and working Python code.
- Covers risk classification, Annex IV technical documentation, cryptographic audit trails (Article 12), liability-bounded escrow patterns, and machine-readable service contracts.
- Features patterns for continuous compliance monitoring and audit logging middleware.
- Includes a 12-week implementation sprint plan targeting the August 2, 2026 compliance deadline.
- All examples utilize the GreenHelix A2A Commerce Gateway API and are production-ready.
